list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network on 2026-11-18 and cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles (both listings agree on every name, description and grade).

summary.hours: About 200 hours to the platinum (PowerPyx estimate, 2026-11-18)
summary.playthroughs: 1 minimum. There are no difficulty settings and no difficulty trophies.
summary.missable: Potentially 1: Positive Mental Attitude. One meditation in Chapter 1 (at Jason's house, with Lucia) may be required and cannot be repeated, because GTA VI has free-roam after the story but no mission replay. Everything else is still doable after the credits.
summary.warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving, so never enter a cheat on a trophy run. The game offers 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave: keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 slots) and rotate the other 5 while cleaning up.

roadmap.title: Play the story, start your collections early
roadmap.detail: Work through all five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Story progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the credits. Two habits pay off for the whole run: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1) and study new animals through the binoculars, because the checklist later asks for 200 vehicle scans and 100 animals studied. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house with Lucia the morning she offers it - it is the one step that may not come back. Keep chapter-boundary saves and never use cheats.
roadmap.trophies: Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma, You Gotta Know When to Get Off, Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm, plus early progress on Positive Mental Attitude, Whip It Good and Master of None.

roadmap.title: Clear the 100% completion checklist
roadmap.detail: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist down. It is far kinder than it sounds - roughly 60% of everything in the game - and most side quests and collectible types are not required at all, or only in part (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons). The parts that must be finished in full are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges and skip the hardest ones. This stage is where A Long Road, the hardest trophy on the list, is earned.
roadmap.trophies: A Long Road, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, One Last Thing, Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control, Fair Game and most of the money trophies.

roadmap.title: Strangers, questlines and final clean-up
roadmap.detail: Strangers & Freaks strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are usually what is left at the end. Finish 8 counting stranger strands and the last missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone - every one of those quest givers is still available in free-roam after the story. Then sweep whatever one-off trophies remain (the airport departure, the tank, the UFO at night, the showroom Banshee) and let Vice Got a Price! pop as the last of the 54.
roadmap.trophies: Strangers & Freaks, Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, The Truth Is Out There, Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: Official PS5 trophy list, PlayStation Network (2026-11-18), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles
GTA Zone - GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements (updated 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as the finish line of Stage 3 rather than a task of its own. No multiplayer, DLC or second playthrough is needed - the whole list is single-player and offline. If it does not pop, compare your earned list against this tracker trophy by trophy; the usual stragglers are a Strangers & Freaks strand or a handful of challenges, neither of which is part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pure story progress: finish Gone Fishing, the opening main mission of Chapter 1, and the trophy pops on completion. It cannot be missed, because the chapter structure is linear and this mission introduces the game's basic movement, driving and phone systems. There are no gold-medal or optional objectives attached to any story trophy in GTA VI, so simply playing the mission at your own pace is enough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy actually registers once you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?), which is how the game confirms the chapter is behind you. While you are still in Chapter 1, do not rush past Jason's house in the mornings: the meditation Lucia offers there belongs to Positive Mental Attitude, the one potentially missable trophy on the list. Make a manual save at the chapter break - you have 15 slots, and chapter-boundary saves are the cheapest insurance in a game with no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; as with Chapter 1, the pop lands when you complete the first main mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City). Chapter 2's mission Coffee Break is an important unlock point even though it has no trophy of its own: from there you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together, which switches on the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), Personal Best strength training and the final meditation spot. Kenton's and Billy's questlines also open up around this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy registers after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). Chapter 3 is the busiest unlock chapter on the list: Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's questlines all start here, Yasmani's jewelry jobs hand you the Snap Gun needed for Sneakthief, and the Credit Check mission unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer behind Dime on the Dollar. None of that side content is required yet - it all stays available after the story - but starting Randy's car list early spreads a long grind across the campaign.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy registers after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Most of the named story-mission trophies (Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown) sit inside this chapter, and its optional cafe mission, That's Where The Money Is..., unlocks the large bank vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. Save before the chapter finale: Chapter 5 is short, and once the credits roll the game returns you to free-roam with the 100% checklist unlocked.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The only gold story trophy: finish the final mission of Chapter 5 and the story is complete. It cannot be missed and there is no alternate-ending branch to worry about for trophies - the relationship and choice systems do not lock any trophy. After the credits you are returned to the open world with everything needed for 100% still accessible, so this trophy marks the start of Stage 2 rather than the end of the run. Keep a pre-finale manual save anyway, as the game has no mission replay if you ever want to revisit it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Like every named-mission trophy on this list it is automatic and cannot be missed: play the mission through to its end card and the trophy pops during the mission flow. No optional objectives, medals or difficulty settings exist for story missions in GTA VI, so a straightforward completion is all that is asked.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. It is a set-piece story heist rather than one of the free-roam robberies, so it cannot be missed or failed permanently: if a section goes wrong the game restarts you at a checkpoint until the mission completes. The free-roam robbery trophies (Maximum Withdrawal, Sneakthief and friends) are separate systems that unlock later, mostly through Yasmani and the Chapter 4 cafe mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. Automatic story progress with no missable window: the mission sits on the chapter's critical path and the trophy pops when it ends. Chapter 4 also carries Headliners and VCIA Takedown, so three named-mission trophies land in this stretch of the campaign.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. As with the other named-mission trophies, completion is the whole requirement - there are no hidden objectives or medal targets, and the linear chapter structure means it cannot be skipped or locked out. The trophy pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission set around Vice City International Airport. Automatic and unmissable. The airport connection is a useful preview: the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can later asks you to steal a passenger jet from a departure terminal at the same airport (terminals E3/E4 are the easy target), so it is worth learning the airfield layout while the story takes you there.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission - the last of the named-mission trophies before the finale. Automatic story progress: complete the mission and the trophy pops, with no optional requirements. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy, so make a fresh manual save before pushing on if you want a clean pre-finale checkpoint.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the centre of Stage 2. The 100% checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but everything you did during the story already counts. It is roughly 60% of the game's true content: most side quests are not required, and big collections are partial - 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons. What must be done in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus any 100 optional missions and any 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing toward it is missable; work the checklist top to bottom in free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four families freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge runs in a small plane are the fastest filler once the jumps run dry. Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots; a stunt only needs to be performed once - its optional challenge layer is not required. Note the 100% checklist separately asks for 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops and the trophy becomes a waypoint, not the finish.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types the tracker counts, once each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check which ones you still owe under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and find the rest on the map with the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon). In practice the story and the 100% checklist introduce almost all nine automatically, so this is normally a five-minute clean-up rather than a project.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges spread across 12 range locations. Every range must be fully golded for the 100% checklist as well, so there is no shortcut version of this one - but the gold scores are forgiving, and replaying a challenge is instant and free. Work range by range, learn each target pattern on a silver run, then push for gold with the weapon class the challenge favours. Progress also raises your Focus stat, which quietly makes Gunslinger easier later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (there are 42 races in total across them, and the checklist wants the full set, so winning one per location is the light version). Drone races are checkpoint time trials: fly the marked line cleanly rather than flat-out, because a missed gate costs more time than a cautious corner. Locations appear on the map as you unfog Leonida; if one will not trigger, check you are at the race's start marker rather than the finish arch.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations - repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh markers. Bring a car that suits the class rather than your favourite all-rounder, and do the short city circuits first: they are quick, forgiving, and teach you the AI's braking habits. Street racing also feeds Yago's Strangers & Freaks strand, so pairing this grind with Stage 3 saves a second tour of the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline from that marker and beat him in his fishing challenge - it is a scored catch contest, so keep every fish you hook rather than releasing small ones early, and upgrade your rod through the questline if the option appears. The questline stays available if you ignore the text, so there is no time pressure on this one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 in-world video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (interact with the controllers), while Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. Completing a game means reaching its end once - its extra challenges do not count. Pick the shortest one you enjoy; the home TV games are the most convenient because you respawn next to them after every story visit home.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-part optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It marks itself automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. The chain runs Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) - the trophy pops at the end of the last one. If Andy goes quiet mid-chain, progress the story a little; like every trophy questline, hers remains fully available after the credits.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton Rees's treasure-diving questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams: Kenton calls, appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento, and marks shipwrecks with purple chest icons. Dive each wreck, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him - 7 shipwrecks in total, tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Do not panic when he becomes unavailable after Chapter 1: he returns in Chapter 2-3 (playing as Jason and calling Brian speeds this up), and the whole chain is still there after the story, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-part questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, which marks itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The chain is Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes - mostly joining Billy on jobs, so bring a fast car and body armour. The trophy pops after the final job, and the entire chain remains available in free-roam after the story if you would rather batch it into Stage 3.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks strands - and note that not every optional questline counts as a 'stranger' strand: the named quest givers with their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone and others) do not count toward this one. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm and his chemical errands), Yago (street racing, ending in Brother to Brother) and Pete the pilot (The Last Mile and his delivery runs), with more strands still being catalogued. Watch the count in the trophy tracker on the trophy list itself, and leave this for Stage 3: strands stay available after the story, and Strangers & Freaks are not part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's Wish List: 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage (the green RK icon in western Vice City). The list opens during the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner and delivers the first car (a Granforma Zorrusso) automatically. The other 15 - among them the Pegassi Infernus, Grotti Itali RSX and Bravado Banshee - can be stolen anywhere: scan traffic with the WAiNK app to spot wishlist models, and hunt around the hotels of Vice Beach / Ocean Beach where they spawn most often. Deliver cars undamaged for better pay, track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and finish leftovers after the story - the questline never expires.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's short questline as Jason (it is not available to Lucia). It marks itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple Synthetic Lab markers appear across Vice City. Destroy labs for the first quest, Take Out Kitty Litter, and once enough labs are down Tyrone hands you the follow-up, Spin On This, which shuts the operation down and pops the trophy. Bring explosives or an assault rifle for the labs, and mop this up any time before or after the credits.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE potentially missable trophy - the only one on the list. There are 18 meditations across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 (track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). The risk is the very first one: during Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in Jason's kitchen one morning and walks out to the balcony - follow her, accept, and meditate with her. That moment never returns, and at the time of writing it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy's counter needs it, so treat it as required. The final spot only unlocks once you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Everything else on the list can wait for free-roam; this one cannot.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (flags this as the 1 potentially missable trophy)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Progress Bret Vogel's hunting questline until you bring him a unique animal. The chain is Jason-only: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His first quest hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (reclaim it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), after which he posts animal requests as purple hunting spots - work them from Map > Activities > Target Deck. All 15 Target Decks are required for the 100% checklist anyway, so this trophy normally lands on its own during Stage 2; clean one-shot kills pay more but are not required.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets out of the 18 sets hidden around Leonida. Cards are small pickups, so work set by set rather than wandering: finish the set you have the most cards in first, and use a location guide for the last few stragglers in each set instead of re-sweeping whole districts. Because only 3 of 18 sets are needed, skip any set whose remaining cards sit in places you cannot reach yet and come back in free-roam - nothing about cards is missable.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then hold R1 to scan) on 100 scannable locations: the pool includes 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, and there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. The fastest route is a slow drive through downtown Vice City and Ocean Beach, scanning everything the app highlights as you pass. Make scanning a habit from Chapter 1 - the same gesture scans vehicles for Whip It Good and Randy's wishlist, so most of this total accumulates for free during the story.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges (browse them under Progress > Challenges and look for the Completed tick). A large share finish passively while you work on other trophies, so leave this until late, sort what remains by effort, and pick off the quick ones - you are allowed to ignore the 30 hardest entirely. For the 100% checklist the bar rises to 70 of 80, which still leaves 10 skips, so the same pick-the-easiest strategy carries you through Stage 2.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. This only becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks roaming as Jason and Lucia together - call your partner with Right + Triangle, cause enough mayhem for 4 stars, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone (the trophy pops when you exit the heat, not the flashing search area). The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the reliable escape: police struggle on the tracks and helicopters cannot see you. In practice it also pops automatically during the big bank vault robberies in Stage 2, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while the police are actively on you the whole time - the flashing wanted level must never fully drop between shops. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break (call your partner with Right + Triangle). Stock up first: body armour, sticky bombs for safes, and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. The 3 jewelry stores in northern Vice City (unlocked by Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together and work well: loot a couple of items and crack the back-room safe in each before moving on. Expect a short delay - the trophy can pop about half a minute after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth while keeping the streak alive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) - scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. The game ships with 557 vehicles, so stand on any busy Vice City road and scan traffic as it passes, then check your totals under Progress > Vehicles. Start in Chapter 1 and this finishes itself: the 100% checklist later demands 200 of the 277 base models, boats and aircraft included, so every early scan is banked progress for Stage 2 as well.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming): it slows time and marks weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds, so set the shot up before you trigger it. Prepare properly - eat, drink or shower to top up the purple focus bar, take Adrenaline to stretch the effect, wear body armour, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up a clustered group at a gang operation (it does not work on police, soldiers or civilians) and sweep without missing. It gets much easier at Focus Level 4, which rises passively from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots - most players earn this naturally during Stage 2.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a departure terminal of VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and take off in it - planes parked loose on the airfield do not count, it must be one connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: cut through the perimeter fence, use the stairs by the bridge to enter the plane, go up to the cockpit, reverse out to the runway and climb away. The pop is delayed until you are roughly 1 km from the airport, so keep flying straight rather than circling back.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and make some heat in it. Tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the main gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot up enemies until the trophy pops - it triggers from using the tank in combat, not merely sitting in it. Expect a heavy wanted response on the way out; the tank can take it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store completely unseen. You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs mission, which also unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons on unfogged map). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in (kicking trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, and interact with the security footage and alarm panel to disable them before you leave - the trophy pops shortly after you exit. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a comfortable first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. The system unlocks in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...: tail a security van until a guard carries the cash case into the bank and the vault opens, then get inside while it is open - bring your partner, because one person cannot carry all the cash (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that mission, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 to mark new targets (finish his Payday Loan jobs first if the option is missing). Every vault robbery means an instant 4-star wanted level: flee on a fast motorcycle, then swap vehicles to go unrecognised. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, and at up to $205,000 each this is also the best endgame income.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape the red heat radius afterwards. The guaranteed route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission behind the bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is...: tailing the truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck, so this normally pops alongside Maximum Withdrawal progress. To do it earlier in free-roam, block a truck near a bank, blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb (find them at Yasmani's shop after his Chapter 3 jobs), grab the cash and break out of the heat - a Pay 'n' Spray also clears you.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. The efficient way is from the air: take a plane and fly slow, overlapping sweeps over every blacked-out region until no fog remains - coastal strips and the far corners of the map are the usual leftovers, so finish with a deliberate border pass. You will clear most of the state naturally during the 100% checklist; treat this as a short dedicated flight at the end of Stage 2 rather than a separate grind.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.count: 1 operation for each of 9 gangs (39 operations exist)
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of Leonida's 9 gangs. Operations appear as yellow map icons when you pass near them, and many are also marked by story progress; track coverage under Progress > Gangs, where each gang shows how many of its operations you have hit. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist requires every one, so this trophy is a free waypoint in Stage 2 - just make sure your early robberies are spread across gangs instead of farming the same one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one-off: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, order an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy - no time-of-day or story requirement. It is an easy 30-second stop whenever you are in the Ocean Beach area for races or Randy's car hunting, and a nice early bank for new players who want a first non-story trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car - the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in southern Vice City - and drive it straight out through the showroom window, a nod to the old GTA III Banshee. It only works with that exact car, and only once you own the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS: clone the key, get in, and accelerate forward through the glass. The pop is slightly delayed until you are a short distance down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the Kolt & Associates gang operations (marked during Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling). Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with the sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup - and the items do not need to be taken in one visit: the operation respawns, so a missed item can be collected on a later run. Not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, the heart icon). Possible only after Chapter 2's Coffee Break lets you switch characters. Strength grows by working out: buy a fitness club membership and always train as a pair - call your partner with Right + Triangle, because while you train one character the other trains automatically, doubling your progress. Filter the map by Activities to find clubs all over Vice City, or work out at home after the story. It is a steady background grind, so sprinkle gym visits between Stage 2 checklist tasks.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile - the exact counter is visible by selecting the trophy in the in-game trophy list. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so a small icon confirms every qualifying action: clean, stealthy robbery work builds the Professional track, incapacitating enemies builds Hardened, killing builds Violent and Psycho. Almost everything in Stage 2 counts, so this lands passively for most players; if it is somehow still short at the end, repeated robberies and encounters farm it quickly. One caution from the profile system: the Irredeemable tier is permanent and makes police shoot on sight more often, so there is no need to chase the most violent actions deliberately.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest status at the time of writing (2026-11-20): this is the one trophy whose trigger the launch-week guides have not confirmed yet - PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be connected to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Until a confirmed method is published, the practical advice is to interact with the prologue's Payday Loans location again in free-roam if you pass it, and to check the sources below for updates rather than trusting any specific claimed method. Everything else on the list is fully documented, so leave this one for last and let the platinum wait on the community confirmation.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (lists this trophy as not yet known, believed Payday Loans related)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside - the spawn is slightly random, so if the car is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path from the car into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, and it will drop the woman it abducted. Talk to her, agree to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians from a moving motorcycle or bicycle with Square, all inside 60 seconds - a melee drive-by, despite the bowling name. Crowd density is everything: ride the pavements of downtown Vice City or the Ocean Beach strip at a busy hour, keep your speed moderate so the kicks connect, and stay on the bike if you clip something. A single dense block usually offers enough targets for the whole chain.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Deliver a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills to your fences. The system unlocks with the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3's Credit Check mission; from then on, banks and Payday Loans yield marked bills when robbed, and you launder them by selling to a fence - Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rate. The total is cumulative across all robberies, never a single delivery. It arrives naturally during the robbery-heavy 100% checklist, and once bank vaults open in Chapter 4 a single vault can hold up to $205,000, so the last stretch goes fast.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across every kind of shop in the game - the counter pools all of them, so nothing needs to be bought in one place. Weapons and attachments at the 24 Ammu-Nations, vehicle mods at the 14 mod shops and Pay 'n' Sprays, and tattoos are the big-ticket sinks that move the counter fastest; clothing, footwear, salons and electronics stores all chip in too. Normal play through Stage 2 (arming up for robberies, modding race cars) usually crosses the line without trying - check it off before deliberately grinding purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count toward this). Garages go on sale after Chapter 2's Daily Driver mission installs the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone - you buy every garage through that app, for $160,000 in total. Fund it with robberies, which pay far better from Chapter 3 onward. Buy them as the money arrives rather than saving up: garage space is also the bottleneck for On the Spot, since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app so they can be delivered to you anywhere. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses mission: drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register, in his garage. Two gates pace this trophy: you need garage parking spots for 10 vehicles (see Little Boxes - buy garages first), and early on Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money per vehicle, so feed it cheap low-end cars and bikes rather than your prize rides.
